selectionObjective: Maximum validation net CAGR; ties prefer shallower drawdown. Start with shared ranks then refine each group in fixed order for at most two passes. Never rank by evaluation results.
execution: Long/flat, no leverage, close-confirmed signal, next actual open, zero cash interest. Relative rebound buys and relative retracement sells; MA defines intervals only. Cold flat at each independent window; terminal position marked at close without exit fee.
